messages:
maria_ml: Quick sync — ran a small-sample bring-up on the 8b variant quantized to int6. Need a recommendation for GTN routing/canary.
sam_eng: Nice. What are the unit-econ and latency tradeoffs?
maria_ml: High level: int6 (8b) = ~32% cost vs fp16 (per-token), p50 latency up ~12ms, p95/tail up ~55ms. Quality: small drop ~0.8 points on our chat ROUGE-like metric, more noticeable on long-context assistant tasks.
maria_ml: Quick numbers snippet:
```
batch=16 p50=72ms p95=210ms
cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.012
quality_delta=-0.8 pts (chat eval)
```
olivia_data: Which prompt set? GTN cares about short compose flows and search snippets — those are sensitive to hallucinations.
maria_ml: Used a mixed set: 60% GTN short-prod-sampled, 40% synthetic long-form assistant cases. Short prompts (<40 tokens) show minimal degradation; long (>200 tokens) drift increases.
sam_eng: Can we fallback for long flows? route long/recall-critical to int8/fp16?
maria_ml: Proposal: default int6 for cost-sensitive low-latency paths; route high-length or high-recall routes to int8. Canary 5% traffic initially. Signals to monitor: task_success, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_cost.
junaid_prod: What are expected monthly savings for GTN if we flip default to int6?
maria_ml: Rough estimate based on GTN usage: current fp16 ~ $2400 / 1M tokens; int6 ~ $890 / 1M tokens => ~63% savings. (Back-of-envelope; will validate on full traffic sample.)
olivia_data: Those savings assume acceptable quality. Add guardrails: automatic eval triggers and rollback thresholds before full rollout.
sam_eng: Infra notes — we need a model-variant header exposed for product routing and a kernel fallback toggle. Also ensure dedicated canary slot so we don't affect shared pools.
maria_ml: I'll draft a playbook + signal set. @deploy-bot any canary windows?
deploy-bot: Canary slot available Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Autoscale can be restricted to avoid spillover during test.
junaid_prod: :thumbsup: Product wants a 1-page PRD for GTN: decision, expected savings, risks, rollback criteria.
maria_ml: Draft checklist I'll include in PRD:
1) Baseline eval on heldout GTN queries (N=2k)
2) Run canary (5%) on dedicated pool
3) Monitor signals for 72h (task_success delta, hallucination delta, latency tail)
4) Auto-rollback if task_success drops >1% or hallucination +0.5%
5) Post-canary A/B survey for UX if any subjective change
Any other required thresholds?
olivia_data: Add latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for GTN flows and token-cost alert at >10% of predicted savings.
sam_eng: I'll prep infra changes (header + toggle) and coordinate with eng-infra.
maria_ml: Thanks — I'll push the PRD link in a bit and ping #gtn-prod. Planning to start canary next Tue.
